# Expose the Decision Contract over HTTP

## Goal

Accept Decision Requests from an HTTP client and return the same sourced Decision Results.

## Dependencies

- `kfw-458-eligibility.decision-runtime`
- `kfw-458-eligibility.decision-evaluation`

## Obligations

- POST `/eligibility-decisions` accepts `application/json` according to the authored request schema.
- The request body at JSON Pointer `` is the invoked contract input.
- HTTP 200 returns `application/json` with the Decision Result at JSON Pointer `` according to the authored response schema.
- Invalid requests return HTTP 400 with `application/json` and error text at JSON Pointer `/error` according to the authored error schema.
- The product publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 document compatible with the generated HTTP contract.

## Verification

```console
uv run --extra dev pytest -q products/kfw_458_eligibility/tests/test_http_contract.py::test_decision_http_cases
```
